planets.name: TOI-1062 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1062 with a 4.12-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1062 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1062. Its orbit and size follow Otegi et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
